definitions.explanation: Music from Western countries, especially pop, rock, and other popular genres from the English-speaking world. Used in contrast to {邦楽|ほうがく} (Japanese music).

examples.japanese: {洋楽|ようがく}をよく{聴|き}く。
examples.english: I often listen to Western music.

examples.japanese: {高校生|こうこうせい}のころ{洋楽|ようがく}にはまった。
examples.english: I got hooked on Western music when I was in high school.

examples.japanese: この{番組|ばんぐみ}では{最新|さいしん}の{洋楽|ようがく}ヒットチャートを{紹介|しょうかい}しています。
examples.english: This program introduces the latest Western music hit charts.

notes:
USAGE:
Used broadly to refer to music from Western countries, particularly English-language popular music. The term pairs with {邦楽|ほうがく} (Japanese music) as a basic categorization in music shops, streaming services, and media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋楽|ようがく}を{聴|き}く (to listen to Western music)
- {洋楽|ようがく}ファン (Western music fan)
- {洋楽|ようがく}チャート (Western music chart)
- {洋楽|ようがく}と{邦楽|ほうがく} (Western and Japanese music)
